column1: # Book 1 second round (Fable, 2026-10-30): full read done in round 1; gloss findings adjudicated here.
# 1.170, 1.179 luminis oras without dias: "the shores of light", per the register rule (HANDOFF item).
# 1.257 pinguis is nominative plural with pecudes (pabula would need pinguia): the cattle are fat, not the pastures.
# 1.289 ruit is transitive, as at 1.272: it dashes down whatever stands against it.
